summary.en: Meadows's traps, Senge's archetypes, Beer, Holling, Luhmann, second-order cybernetics, Ashby, Wiener and Ostrom, from AI knowledge with no source text checked. The account has forms for the commons, success to the successful, wrong goals, late regulation and, run downward, eroding goals; it has no law for burden-shifting, the adaptive cycle, viable-system structure or rule evasion. Divergence is real: feedback as purpose, Beer's organs, von Foerster's imperative, constructivism, Luhmann, panarchy's ladder, self-governance.

name.en: Tragedy of the commons as a trap of missing feedback

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems: A Primer (2008)
source.locator: chapter 5, System Traps: Tragedy of the Commons

sense.en: A shared resource erodes because the feedback from its condition to its users is missing or too delayed, while each user's gain from use is direct. The ways out as she lists them: educate and exhort, privatize so each bears its own consequences, or regulate by mutual coercion.

reading.en: The joint-excess law has the form, and privatizing has the form of exclusive footprints. But restoring feedback is scoped: coupling is the first of six conditions; a goal over the shared level is itself no guarantee; and where the rest outruns the renewal no weight on a reading of the condition from the rest's end selects a member's restraint. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; the ending also activity needing support, only active giving, the gate local). Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; n consecutive such steps from below n + m end every dependent at need m or more. Marked near-definitional arithmetic; not who ought to take less.

Theorem (World). Where the rest alone take jointly more than a step gives across n steps from below n + m, dependents end whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike.

Theorem (World: balance). With takes divided by exclusive footprints at every step the level never falls below its start. It does not show that an actual division is by exclusive footprints, or that the level rises.

Theorem (World, with the local premises named). Alike preferences, each over one's own, are not one goal; a goal over the shared level is no guarantee either: two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: enough of the situation is coupling, response, time, resolution, pace and structure at once; observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient.

account_adds.en: An exact end under the gate; that a restored coupling still fails where the rest outruns the renewal; that no law calls the drain a harm (asked under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted).

source_adds.en: Education and exhortation as an exit, on which the nearest live evidence is IN1 (LLM fishers kept no dependent they were not told of, under any instruction), and mutual coercion, since 05 §12 models an entry rule and no sanctions. Her claim carries a practical judgement the laws do not.

name.en: Success to the successful

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes
source.locator: Meadows chapter 5, Success to the Successful; Senge appendix 2

sense.en: Winners are rewarded with the means to win again, a reinforcing loop that ends in exclusion of the losers. Exits as Meadows lists them: diversify so losers can compete elsewhere, limit the winners' share (antitrust), level the field periodically, reward what does not bias the next round.

reading.en: Two laws have the lock's form: a rule read from the share it selects, and a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices. A rule read against the share is the levelling exit's form; a held reversal not absorbed is the reset's. Drawn one member at a time, a kind fixes or is lost, which is exclusion's form, and noise leaves the lock. That rules read the share is a premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). With selection not lowering a target's share under a favouring rule, the rule read monotonically from the share, and start and readings favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise. A perturbation reversing the direction, held past a threshold, is not absorbed (witness).
Theorem (counts, two policies, a standing score). A threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves. Read in 02 as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989) [AI reading].

Theorem (any type). Where the rule is read against the share, selection under favouring rules does not lower it, and the rules favour at every step, a later reading's rule is not above an earlier one's.

Theorem (counts). Drawn one member at a time among M + 1, the rule read at each step at the current count: histories still varied vanish geometrically, the share fixing the shapers tends to the potential at the start over that at the top, and noise leaves either lock.

account_adds.en: Exactly what leaves a lock (a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection); that a count lock holds also where a standing score favours the other policy; that drift leaves some locks.

source_adds.en: The loop through resources, winners' means raising their next win, where the laws read a rule from a share; diversification, and limits on the winners' share, for which no law was found.

name.en: Seeking the wrong goal

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008)

sense.en: A system obediently produces what its goal or indicator specifies, whatever was intended; effort is confused with result, as with GNP counted for welfare. The way out: indicators and goals that reflect the system's real welfare.

reading.en: A selection reaches exactly what couples into it, and with room its optima drain what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. This has the trap's form between indicator and what the indicator omits. The law says nothing of 'wrong': that needs something comparing, which the account names rather than assumes. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Every order rising with what couples in has its optima least beyond exactly where no eligible outcome above another beyond is unbeaten on it; room is a hypothesis. No evaluation: not that the fall beyond is a harm. Read as the proxy problem (Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell 2020) [AI reading].

Thesis T3. Optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings, where that gives room. The law for optima is proved; the clause on actual trained systems is conjectured, with partial support and its locus unresolved.

account_adds.en: Where the trap does not bite: no room, no drain; exact conditions at optima. Which order a goal must rise in is left open.

source_adds.en: That a goal can be right or wrong against a system's real welfare, a comparison the laws do not state: any ranking is under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. Also the confusion of effort with result, which no law addresses.

name.en: Rule beating

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008)

sense.en: Those under a rule act so as to meet its letter and defeat its intent, as with departments spending a budget by year's end so it is not cut. She reads the response as useful feedback, and the way out as redesigning rules to release that creativity toward the purpose.

reading.en: A rule is a selection through what couples into it, so acts it couples alike are selected alike, whatever else they do: that gap is rule beating's room, and 03 reads it as the proxy problem (Goodhart). With room, optima of what the letter reads drain what it omits. Agreement holds of the room only: PLAN §6.3 lists this trap with no target, and no law gives evasion's dynamics. [AI reading]

says.en: A selection goes through a formation's couplings where histories alike through them are selected alike. Read: what it can depend on is fixed before any question of how well it optimizes. Its main law holds by construction; its force lies in supplied premises.

Theorem. Every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond, condition by condition, exactly where no eligible outcome above another beyond goes unbeaten on the family. Room is a hypothesis.

Theorem (root; a family of models). Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them. Not modelled: conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision.

account_adds.en: The exact bound on what any rule can reach through what couples in.

source_adds.en: The adaptive response itself, actors learning the gap between letter and intent, and reading it as feedback for redesign. Intent as distinct from letter has no law here: 05 §12 explicitly merges compliance into one count.

name.en: Policy resistance

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Jay W. Forrester, Counterintuitive Behavior of Social Systems (1971)
source.locator: Meadows chapter 5, Policy Resistance; Forrester locator unverified

sense.en: Several actors with inconsistent goals each pull one stock toward their own. A policy that moves it pulls it from the others' goals, and they pull back harder, so effort rises while the stock stays. Ways out as she lists them: let go, or find a goal that serves all.

reading.en: Two partial forms. Absorption has the outcome: a change of the rule's value is undone at the next reading, with no rival goals in it, and only where the direction is kept, which scopes "systems resist". Rejoining has the accounting: a difference closes only through a formation outside the part, making up the gap exactly. Rival goals on one stock, the source's cause, 05 lists as open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Locked, a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; a perturbation reversing it, held past the threshold, is not absorbed (witness). That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (World). Where a difference closes over a stretch, what the two exchanged then makes up the starting gap exactly. Where the rest follows a law reading through its couplings, a difference closes only through a formation outside the part that the courses' couplings tell apart. Coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.

Theorem (any type). Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That any actual rule or reading is so formed is the premise.
Theorem (any type). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step (Law.perturbation_reabsorbed).
Open, for orders with a set point: conflicting set points on a shared condition.

account_adds.en: Where resistance holds and fails in one loop (direction kept, threshold crossed); an exact accounting of what closes a difference.

source_adds.en: The trap's core: inconsistent goals on one stock, with effort escalating while the level holds. No law states it; conflicting set points are listed as open. 'Let go' and an overarching goal have no law.

name.en: Escalation

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes

sense.en: Each party sets its stock relative to the other's, trying to get ahead, so a reinforcing loop runs exponentially until one party collapses or the loop is broken. Exits as Meadows lists them: unilateral disarmament, or a negotiated system with balancing loops.

reading.en: Pieces stand apart: zero-sum position says why no one gets ahead for all; a race draws everything in one model; a rising take gives the pace to an end; a witness loop has a supplied reply law; a loop closes only through a link giving back less, a negotiated exit's form. No law derives the rise from reading the other's stock. `escalating` in the renewal records means a rising draw, another sense. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type for the counting). Positions' rises total their falls; a part's rise needs another's fall. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

Theorem (any law G, natural amounts). Drawers in turn ranking position over the steps left: among two or more a best response for position keeps nothing; where what stands from nothing is least, every profile perfect for position draws everything. Not that actual races are played so.

Theorem (any type; World for the ring). Where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less; with whole-number factors never gradually.

Theorem (World). A take more than now at every step, from a condition given at most B a step, takes all that is given within B + 1 steps and the seeker ends. The rise is supplied here, not derived from what taking gains.

Record's witness: in the escalation loop the second formation's reply is a law, in the step after its own condition falls it takes two units from the first's, reading what has stood and only what the second observes. The law is supplied.
Includes a witness, an escalation loop: the first takes from the second's condition at step 0, the second responds at step 1 by taking from the first's. That the rest so responds is supplied.

account_adds.en: That a best response for position keeps nothing, so unilateral restraint is not selected by a position ranking; the exact closing condition of a loop; that position does not protect, the greatest part dying with the rest where it depends on the condition.

source_adds.en: A law in which each raises its stock by reading the other's: PLAN §4.4 lists escalation among gaps, and I found none. Unilateral disarmament as an exit has no law, and against a position ranking the race law cuts against it.

name.en: Eroding goals, drift to low performance

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes
source.locator: Meadows chapter 5, Drift to Low Performance; Senge appendix 2, Eroding Goals

sense.en: The standard is set from perceived past performance, and perception leans negative, so a low result lowers the goal, which allows a lower result: a slow reinforcing decline with no alarm. The way out: keep standards absolute, or set them from the best results.

reading.en: PLAN's seed holds as a form. In one loop a rule read monotonically from a share also runs down: a reversal held past the threshold leaves neither share nor rule rising, and from a start below, or strictly disfavoured, the share falls strictly at every step. Keeping standards absolute is a rule not reading the share. Set points in 05 §7 are supplied, so this is not stated of a set point or a need. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; witness). A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed: from the step after it neither share nor rule rises, and the rule after the first reading step is below the one before. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (counts). Every such course is locked one way at every step; strictly disfavoured at the start, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step, the shapers present. Readers drawn from those selected is a premise; constants; without noise.
Theorem (counts). At a threshold, with lo < c < hi, from a start below the shapers' share falls strictly at every step. That what comes back is read from the share is a premise.

account_adds.en: The threshold or start that decides which way the same loop runs, and what leaves it: a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection.

source_adds.en: The cause: perception leaning negative, so decline is slow and raises no alarm. The laws' falls come from a start or a reversal, in counts. A need or set point read from the level; and setting standards from the best results, a reading no law states.

name.en: Shifting the burden to the intervenor, addiction

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes
source.locator: Meadows chapter 5, Shifting the Burden to the Intervenor; Senge appendix 2

sense.en: A quick intervention relieves a symptom, and the system's own capacity to solve the problem atrophies, so more intervention is needed: a reinforcing dependence on the help. The way out as Meadows states it: strengthen the system's own capacity first, then withdraw.

reading.en: Only the withdrawal half has a form, comparing separately started members. A reader rebuilt from the supply is gone after its span under a cut, where one rebuilt from the level buys time; at s ≤ l a rule taught by members has no holder left after s steps, where taught from outside each new cohort holds it. Neither has help lowering what was there. Family D's habit lock and E's waiting, PLAN's seeds, are other loops. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Capacity eroded by the support that replaces it, so that withdrawal hurts more than before. No law found in which outside giving lowers a formation's own later giving; 05 §10 says only, as a reading, that a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.

read: PLAN Appendix A rows D and E

name.en: A ranked list of places to intervene

source.work: Donella H. Meadows, Leverage Points: Places to Intervene in a System (1999)

sense.en: Places to intervene ranked from weak to strong: numbers, buffers, stock-and-flow structure, delays, balancing and reinforcing loops, information flows, rules, the power to self-organize, goals, paradigms, transcending paradigms. Offered as tentative, from practice. Numbers rarely matter, she says, unless they kick off something higher on the list.

reading.en: The locks bear out one clause and scope it: a value change is absorbed only where the direction is kept, and exact thresholds decide a step or an end, which is her own exception. A course of a process's own moves adds nothing to its whole possible, which bears on her placing rules above what runs under them. But no law ranks these, and the laws locate an end, ordering nothing. "Higher" reads her comparison. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Courses alike in share and rule stay alike where nothing reads the beyond; the lock outlives the loss; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed.
Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever comes to every member alike; a smaller cost gives a rule not lower.
Theorem (the regime; whole numbers; one condition under a standing draw). The point of no return is exact. They locate an end, ordering nothing.

Theorem (root; any process). Where every step of a stretch is one of a process's moves, what is possible under it at the end was possible at the start; keeping widening needs bounded stretches not made of its moves.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions, in models, for when a parameter decides and when a change is absorbed; six conditions read in CD §6, none ranked. Calling one intervention better would need C for order and the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: The ranking itself, its reach across systems as judged from practice, and goals, paradigms and transcending them, for which no law here stands. Whether the ranking is right is not tested by anything in the account.

name.en: A balancing loop with delay oscillates

source.work: Jay W. Forrester, Industrial Dynamics (1961); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes
source.locator: Forrester's production-distribution chain, locator unverified; Senge appendix 2, Balancing Process with Delay

sense.en: A corrective loop whose information or action lags overshoots, then over-corrects, and oscillates, amplifying up a chain; aggressive correction in response to delay makes it worse. Structure, not outside shocks, generates the behaviour. Waiting, or shortening the delay, helps.

reading.en: The account's regulation laws have this form on discrete whole amounts: overshoot exactly past the gap, a band a late-reading rule cannot beat, proportional to the lag, and giving that overcompensates cycling in a witness. They state what a lag costs, not a period or amplitude. 08 marks regulation as restating deadbeat control. The Lean comparison of delayed gains stands only in history/SYSTEMS-COMPLEXITY-CHAOS.md. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance at the condition). The bound on the joint exchange is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever. Theorem (any type): a rule reading l steps late keeps no band narrower than 2(l + 1)d against rests moving the level at most d a step.

Adjustment rising in both and resting at the draw exactly where the regime gives it, band up to hi: every run within the band rests within a bound; whether it changes again is decided at each step. Overcompensating giving can cycle for ever (a witness).

account_adds.en: An exact, attained bound on band width by lag, and an exact relay threshold.

source_adds.en: Amplification along a supply chain, the period and amplitude of cycles, and structure as the source of behaviour across social systems. 02 and PLAN list when a regime cycles and with what period as having no law; the cycles present are witnesses.

name.en: Fixes that fail

source.work: Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990)

sense.en: A fix works at once, and its unintended consequences return after a delay through a reinforcing loop, worsening the symptom and calling for more of the same fix.

reading.en: Three laws carry parts: more at first, less past a bound, under a supplied wear law; a switch keeping a formation active while what sustains it ends; and a difference returning to the part, unseen in a comparison with the rest fixed. Each has "it worked, and did not", none being a fix repeated. Senge's loop is present and delayed, where the loop-onset witness is absent then formed. No law says better or worse here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; a supplied wear law with no recovery). Consuming formation can form more at first, so a one-step count ranks it first; past a bound every continuation within renewal exceeds every one beyond. The wear law carries much of this; sign-neutral.

Theorem (World). In the support-gated law with a substitutable condition, the focal formation stays active at every step by switching, is still consuming, and the sustaining formation ends. Substitution keeps it active without undoing its consumption; whole-run reading only.

Theorem (World). Where the rest responds through its couplings, the comparison is decided within the responsive reach. That the rest so responds is supplied. Its record: in the escalation loop the difference returns to the part, which does not show with the rest fixed.

Theorem (World). A loop that forms passes through a coupling acting at that step; before it forms growth is at most polynomial, and a loop forming at T and one forming at any later step carry the same amounts up to T (a witness): the amounts need not show when one forms.

account_adds.en: That a one-step count ranks the consuming course first; that a record of amounts cannot show a loop's coming onset, in these models.

source_adds.en: The specific shape: a fix whose delayed side effect worsens the very symptom, and the pressure that repeats it. No law states the return on the symptom or the repetition.

name.en: Growth and underinvestment

source.work: Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990)

sense.en: Growth nears a limit that capacity investment could lift, but the need for investment is judged too late or the standard is lowered to excuse it, so performance falls, demand falls, and the fall seems to justify not investing.

reading.en: Neighbours differ. Laws on keeping and rebuilding a base speak of optima, not a lagged decision, and more-needs-renewers is about upkeep scaling. The trap joins a late reading, an eroding standard and demand read from performance; each of these is missing or separate here. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A loop where performance feeds demand and investment lags, with self-justifying decline.

name.en: The law of requisite variety

source.work: W. Ross Ashby, An Introduction to Cybernetics (1956)

sense.en: Only variety can absorb variety: the variety of outcomes a regulator can hold is bounded below by the variety of disturbances divided by the regulator's variety, also given in entropy form. A claim about any regulator, independent of mechanism.

reading.en: The account reads the covering law's failure as requisite variety on relations, and 08 marks regulation as restating it. What it states is qualitative and exact: a common response exists where the acts' kernels cover the situations. It has no count of variety. Dossiers S and A both ask whether it adds anything. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root: any carrier, reading and requirement, the requirement supplied). A response common over a reading within a requirement exists exactly where the acts' kernels cover the situations. Reading [AI]: a reading too coarse is the covering's failure, requisite variety read on relations; which requirement is right it does not say.

In the three-route process each of two binary readings is adequate while every reading coarser than both is inadequate, so a task can lack a coarsest adequate reading; in a regulation band, success changes what the next success needs.

account_adds.en: That a task can lack a coarsest adequate reading; that success can change what the next success needs.

source_adds.en: The quantitative law, its entropy form, and variety engineering by amplifying and attenuating. No live statement counts variety.

name.en: Every good regulator must be a model of the system

source.work: Roger C. Conant and W. Ross Ashby, Every good regulator of a system must be a model of that system (1970)

sense.en: The simplest optimal regulator of a system is, under their assumptions, a homomorphic image of it: regulation that is both optimal and simplest maps system states to regulator states.

reading.en: The account takes up regulation by what couples in and does not assert the conclusion. 03 and 08 both set this law apart from the theorem: a safety composition, not optimality, with nothing proved of a regulator's having to model what it regulates. A coarser reading can suffice where its further worlds ask compatible acts. That bears on the popular wider reading, not on their theorem. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root for closure; any types for the loop; near-definitional, with one general law). A policy keeps a task exactly where each state's act can be taken at every world its reading admits and leads only where the task holds. Reading: nothing of optimality or of having to model what it regulates is proved here.

account_adds.en: The history form of what a regulator acting from what couples in must meet; that a coarser reading can suffice.

source_adds.en: The optimality-and-simplicity theorem itself, untouched here.

name.en: Ultrastability: a second loop that changes the first

source.work: W. Ross Ashby, Design for a Brain (1952)

sense.en: Adaptation by double feedback: a first loop regulates through set parameters; when essential variables leave their limits, a second loop changes those parameters step by step, at random, until a field keeping the essential variables within limits is found and retained. The homeostat is his demonstration.

reading.en: One live record uses the term: a witness that cycles with its selector unchanged, so recurrence alone is no evidence of adaptation. That scopes an inference; it does not state ultrastability. The fuller comparison stands only in history/CYBERNETICS.md. Pace and pool laws speak of a rule changing at reading steps, without an essential-variable trigger or a search. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (one declared process; witness; pre-spine; reviewed, not receipt-bound). A process returns after two steps and changes at every step while its selector stays the same. Refutes an unconditional inference from recurrence to learning or selector revision, not learning in a richer process. Ashby's term stands in the record, as the AI's reading.
Theorem (any type). A two-level course, the rule changing only at reading steps, is a run of one law; a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step.

account_adds.en: That a two-level course is one law's run, so a second loop is no new kind of thing.

source_adds.en: The step-change triggered by essential variables leaving limits, random search to a stable field, and how long adaptation takes. 03's Open lists an institution revising its rule of reading.

name.en: The viable system model

source.work: Stafford Beer, Brain of the Firm (1972); The Heart of Enterprise (1979)

sense.en: Any system capable of independent existence must have five functions: operations, coordination, control, intelligence, policy, with channels of variety balancing them, an alarm channel that bypasses levels, and recursion, each viable unit containing and contained in viable units. Beer claims these are necessary and sufficient.

reading.en: Beer asserts organs every viable system must have. The account gives none: root laws forbid no relation, a required organization appears only under the two premises with the relation supplied, and keeping each guard does not decide keeping them together, so a checklist is not the joint question. `Viability.kernel` is a guard's invariance kernel, a word match. Late reading and pools touch the alarm channel only as readings of a loss. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation; a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted; J1 to J4; actual improvement witnesses). If every eligible continuation lacking a relation has a strictly better one, the undefeated choices include it. No compliance, no institutional authority; overbuilding is its counterexample.

Theorem. Counting every course, no course leaves two guards together exactly where none leaves either; in a witness each can be kept along some run while the two cannot together, and no rule decides the joint answer from the separate ones. A product of viabilities is a heuristic.

account_adds.en: That a list of separately keepable conditions does not decide the joint course, in a witness.

source_adds.en: The five functions, the variety channels, the alarm channel and recursion as a structural law. The two grains and nested joint plans state nesting without saying what each level needs; 05 §4's reading of social viability lists constraints by law, not organs, and is not Beer's.

name.en: The purpose of a system is what it does

source.work: Stafford Beer, What is cybernetics? (2002)

sense.en: A diagnostic maxim: there is no point in claiming a system's purpose is something it constantly fails to do. Read its purpose from its behaviour, not from what its designers or members say.

reading.en: The account agrees stated purposes do not bind, and scopes the inference: acts do not fix what they come from. One observed course can leave an unresolved model and a reversed ranking indistinguishable, and choices show only the reach of an order. Read as a diagnostic the maxim stands; read as identifying purpose from acts, it goes past these models. "Purpose" itself has no law; 05 §12 lists purposes as not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any types; a witness). A relation between two blanketed laws' configurations that their steps keep, with sensed values and acts one, gives the same at every step, so no selection through those tells them apart; in the witness, a formation holding both candidates and one with the reverse ranking act alike.

Theorem (root; near-definitional). Every transitive relation in which what is chosen stands above every other open alternative contains the reach of the shown relation; comparisons outside that reach stay open.

account_adds.en: The exact part of an order that choices show.

source_adds.en: A working stance for diagnosing organizations: refuse stated intention as an account of behaviour. The laws do not speak to that use.

name.en: Resilience against stability

source.work: C. S. Holling, Resilience and stability of ecological systems (1973)
source.locator: Annual Review of Ecology and Systematics 4

sense.en: Stability is how fast a system returns to equilibrium after a small disturbance; resilience is how much disturbance it absorbs before moving to another domain of attraction. They are separate: a highly fluctuating population can be resilient, and managing for steadiness can shrink the domain.

reading.en: The margin has resilience's form for one condition, the return multiplier stability's. Near a fold, linearized, these are tied. The exit from a margin holds swing size and margin apart, a bound giving his separation a form, not his claim. Below the regime's point lies an end, though 05 reads a shock into another retained region on one model. Managing for steadiness shrinking the domain has no law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the regime; any giving law, whole numbers). For one condition under a standing draw, a level up to the top ends exactly where it starts below H + y. Locates an end, ordering nothing. CD §5: in yeast driven past its fold, the regime's margin timed neither of the two breaks.

Theorem (periphery, Mathlib; discrete steps, one variable linearized about a rest). At a fold and at a transcritical end under a proportional draw, the multiplier rises to one as the margin shrinks, so the margin to a condition's own end couples into its fluctuations. A dependent's need enters neither statistic.

Theorem (two values, natural weights p and q, independent steps). A level m above a need, raised q and lowered p: courses of n steps reaching the need take at most n·p·q/m² of the weight. Kolmogorov's maximal inequality restated in counting form.
Theorem (any type). Under a determined law courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; within m listed configurations each basin holds one cycle.

Reading [AI, D65, on a market model]. Four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition, among them a shock into another retained region. Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support.

account_adds.en: That a condition's statistics warn of its own end and not of a dependent's need (T6, its across-domains form conjectured).

source_adds.en: Several domains with a law of shift between them, and resilience as a management aim; that suppressing variation erodes resilience. PLAN lists transitions between regions on the World, and hysteresis, among gaps; the word hysteresis stands only in two records' correspondence fields.

name.en: The adaptive cycle

source.work: C. S. Holling, Understanding the complexity of economic, ecological, and social systems (2001); Gunderson and Holling (eds), Panarchy (2002)
source.locator: Ecosystems 4 for the 2001 paper; book locator unverified

sense.en: Many complex systems pass through growth (r), conservation (K), release (Ω) and reorganization (α). In K, connectedness and stored potential rise while resilience falls, so a small shock can release much; release frees what reorganization uses. Offered as a heuristic with stated exceptions.

reading.en: The account's cycles are witnesses, with no law of when or with what period. It holds back from the frame: 02 lists no universal phase threshold between regions among what it does not show, and 05 keeps four routes of transition distinct, none a proved phase transition. So no law denies a four-phase cycle; it has no form here, and connectedness lowering resilience has no statement. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: An ordered sequence of phases; release as enabling renewal; and connectedness trading against resilience.

searched: PLAN §4.2 and Appendix A row F
release (found ActivationCapacity and retaining and releasing a coupling, other senses)
read: 02 What this chapter does not show and Open
05 §10 reading on four routes of transition, after r-market-model-share-margin-and-ends

name.en: Panarchy: revolt and remember across scales

source.work: Gunderson and Holling (eds), Panarchy (2002)

sense.en: Adaptive cycles are nested, small and fast within large and slow. A fast level's release can cascade upward (revolt); a slow level's stored memory supplies what a fast level reorganizes from (remember). Sustainability lies in those two connections.

reading.en: Pieces, and a parting. A cascade runs along total dependence, its direction fixed by dependence and not scale. A slow rule reads a fast level only at reading steps, with no toppling. A formation renewed from outside can be active again (`Restored.returns`), which is only near remember. And 04 reads cell to ecosystem as no fixed ladder, "upward" and "downward" being relational paths, where panarchy orders levels by speed and size. [AI reading]

says.en: Any number of conditions, any index type. Under mutual support raising a level never ends one that held; along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all.

At a fine and a coarse class and on branches, the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch. Does not show that this generation is the 生生 of life in the whole, or that renewal is generation.
Theorem (any type). A fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, L steps fix every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.

Reading after this law [AI, D65], Part and whole: cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder. "Upward" and "downward" name different relational paths within one unfolding.

account_adds.en: An exact pace bound between a slow rule and a fast level.

source_adds.en: Nesting by speed and size as an organizing law, and the two named cross-scale routes. None stated.

name.en: Resonance: a closed system reacts only in its own terms

source.work: Niklas Luhmann, Ökologische Kommunikation (1986), English Ecological Communication (1989)

sense.en: Society is operationally closed, in touch with its environment only by structural coupling. Ecological danger exists for it only as it resonates in function systems' own codes: a price, a legal ruling, a scientific result. So there can be too little resonance, and also too much, inside the code.

reading.en: The selection law has the first half's form: two histories alike through a selector's couplings are kept or dropped together, however hard the selection presses, so a loss enters only through what couples in. Same form, not same reference: Luhmann's terms are communications and codes, and 'couplings' here is the account's relation, not structural coupling. Too much resonance has no law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance on what couples in), blindness. In the witness Clearing a dweller ends in one world and not the other while every selection through the clearer's couplings selects them alike. The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise.
Theorem (any type). Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike, exactly then along every schedule; the lock outlives the loss.

account_adds.en: Exactness and exits under hypotheses; that a pooled coupling reaches the union of its members' closures.

source_adds.en: Codes as what closes a system; over-resonance; and the claim that any response is itself internal communication that produces further problems for it.

name.en: Social systems are made of communications, not people

source.work: Niklas Luhmann, Soziale Systeme (1984)

sense.en: A social system's elements are communications that produce further communications (autopoiesis on Maturana's model, lifted beyond life). People belong to its environment. The founding difference is system and environment.

reading.en: Both start from relation over substance, and that is the extent of it. The account's method asks that every split state its basis and omissions, including system and environment, and counts formations, whose losses (under the continuation condition for scope, with C for any order, neither asserted) are not removed by being environment. Luhmann's cut places people outside society. This is my contrast; the account never discusses him. [AI reading]

says.en: Distinctions state their basis: subject and object, observer and world, inside and outside, fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out. A separate type asserts no fundamental separation.

Reading [AI, D45, D61]. A boundary is given by a region; along a relation, by a region holding the formation and closed under the relation. Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed; every boundary holds the closure.

account_adds.en: Boundaries that depend on the relation followed, none fixed as the founding one.

source_adds.en: A theory of the social in which communications are the only elements and function systems are closed by binary codes. Not carried.

name.en: A society with no centre from which to steer

source.work: Niklas Luhmann, Die Gesellschaft der Gesellschaft (1997); Ökologische Kommunikation (1986)

sense.en: A functionally differentiated society has no apex or centre. Each description of it, and each attempt to steer it, is made inside one subsystem, in that subsystem's code. Steering a whole from a part is, on this view, unavailable; one part can only irritate others.

reading.en: Kept as the strongest test of the form that speaks of a collective's course, pooling couplings and a joint selection. The account answers part: no guarantee; no administrator entitled to speak for everything; coupling bounds response without fixing it. But it speaks as if pooled readers can respond together. Luhmann would ask who that pool is, and in what code it reads. How pools form is open. [AI reading]

says.en: A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each holding under stated hypotheses, including pooled couplings; none shown to hold of an actual collective. The page's answer begins: no guarantee.

A group's closure is the union of its members'; a pool separates exactly what some member separates. It does not show which formations pool, how a pool forms or lasts, or that a pool responds to what it separates.

account_adds.en: Exact reach of a pool and of a rule read through it.

source_adds.en: The argument that no such reader of the whole can exist within a differentiated society, which the account neither answers nor tests.

name.en: Autopoiesis: a system producing what produces it

source.work: Humberto Maturana and Francisco Varela, Autopoiesis and Cognition (1980; earlier Spanish 1972)

sense.en: A living system is a network of processes producing the components that realize the network, with its own boundary: organizationally closed, materially open. Its organization is conserved through turnover of parts, and that closure, rather than purpose, defines the living.

reading.en: The account names it as a neighbour and says how far short its models stop. Generation as a pattern going on through renewal of parts is "close to" it, a correspondence not proved. The member rebuilt from the level is one constraint with turnover, below autopoiesis. And what tells that member from a thermostat, 04 reads, is no closure or loop but a stock buying time and an end that does not come back. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, new]: the member rebuilt from the level is a minimal model of an organism, one constraint with turnover regenerated from the flow it regulates, below closure of constraints, autopoiesis and Rosen's closure, each of which asks more.
At a fine and a coarse class, the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch. Its correspondence: close to autopoiesis (Maturana and Varela). That renewal is generation is not shown.

account_adds.en: A stock setting when a line ends, and an end that does not come back, in the model; regions of generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains.

source_adds.en: Self-produced boundary, organizational closure as such, and the definition of the living by it, which the account says its models do not meet.

name.en: Double contingency as what order forms from

source.work: Niklas Luhmann, Soziale Systeme (1984), after Talcott Parsons
source.locator: the chapter on double contingency, locator unverified

sense.en: Where each party's act depends on the other's, both knowing it, nothing determines the first move. For Luhmann that very indeterminacy drives system formation: any chance move, a glance or a tone, starts a history that narrows what follows, so order arises from noise, with no prior consensus.

reading.en: The account has the deadlock and the break in exact form. Giving that waits on giving stays withheld; without a sparing formation total withholding stays. From a symmetric start a shared form is settled only by what breaks the symmetry, and a swap-symmetric rule singles out no role. So 'order arises' is scoped: it needs an actual asymmetry or noise, which is his point, and can fail. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type: any relation of waiting). With memory, one withholding, where every formation lies within d waits of it, ends all giving from step d on. The relation of waiting is given.
Under hearings copying a form in use, formations come to one form for a sense only by hearing one another; from a symmetric start, which form wins is settled only where something breaks the symmetry.

Theorem (two roles; periphery module). A predicate invariant under the swap cannot hold of exactly one; among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure, whose warrant is open.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions under which waiting absorbs and under which symmetry blocks a shared form, including deterministic counted codes never sharing.

source_adds.en: Expectations of expectations, reflexive anticipation; the account's waiting relation is supplied and reads acts. The claim that this is how social systems in general begin.

name.en: The observer is part of what is observed

source.work: Heinz von Foerster, Cybernetics of Cybernetics (1974) and On Constructing a Reality (1973); Humberto Maturana, Biology of Cognition (1970)

sense.en: Description cannot be separated from the describer: anything said is said by an observer, and objectivity as observer-free description is an illusion. Second-order cybernetics studies observing systems, and in its stronger constructivist form holds that reality as known is computed by the observer, not received.

reading.en: The inclusion is stated: reading is within the unfolding, and observer-dependence is the choice of class. The constructivist step is not. The account keeps differences beyond any selector's couplings as differences of the web: a loss can stand beyond every closure, and is unread rather than unreal. Same stance on the knower, different on what lies past knowing. history/CYBERNETICS.md noted this. [AI reading]

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.
In the witness 'No clear boundary': overlapping identities are several classes, observer-dependence is the choice of class, and a vague boundary appears only as a relation that is not a class.

Theorem (World; balance on what couples in), blindness. In the witness Clearing a dweller ends in one world and not the other while every selection through the clearer's couplings selects them alike; the dweller's admission separates them, through their pooled coupling.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of what a formation's couplings do and do not separate.

source_adds.en: Constructivism about reality; the claim that an observer's activity constitutes its objects. The account does not assert this, and its World model takes levels as given.

name.en: Objects as tokens for eigenbehaviours

source.work: Heinz von Foerster, Objects: Tokens for (Eigen-)Behaviors (1976)

sense.en: A recursive operation applied to its own results settles on fixed points, whatever the start, under conditions. What we know as stable objects are such eigenvalues of our recursive coordination of perception and action.

reading.en: The nearest law is prediction read by what it predicts: publishing and responding is an orbit, right exactly at a fixed point. It scopes "settles" and "whatever the start": an order-keeping response on a chain reaches its least right prediction, a threshold response has two with the start deciding, a response moving every value has none. Near-definitional mostly, and about prediction, not objects. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; 0 to n for the chain; near-definitional, one general law). Right exactly where the response to it is itself; where the response moves every value, none is right. Under a response keeping the chain and its order the least right prediction is reached by step n. In a witness a threshold response has two, the start deciding.

account_adds.en: When such a fixed point fails to exist; that negation alternates without rest; that the start can decide which is reached.

source_adds.en: That objects of knowledge are these fixed points. Not stated, and not a claim of the account.

name.en: Observing observers, and the blind spot

source.work: Niklas Luhmann, Die Wissenschaft der Gesellschaft (1990); Heinz von Foerster, On Constructing a Reality (1973)

sense.en: An observer cannot see the distinction it uses while using it. A second-order observer can see what the first cannot, at the cost of its own blind spot; there is no last observer. "We do not see that we do not see" is von Foerster's phrase as I recall it; which paper is uncertain.

reading.en: Four laws have parts of the form. A course chosen through a model tests only what that course exposes. Reading another's couplings gives the union of closures, no further. Self-reference does not certify itself. A family of readings indexed by what it reads leaves a gap at every step, near "no last observer". Their blindness is of couplings, untried courses and diagonals, a different object from a distinction in use. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any types, on a blanketed law; a witness). Two worlds give one sensed course exactly as long as they answer alike the act taken at the value sensed. Reading: a model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model.

Theorem (World; the closure identity under a stated hypothesis). A formation coupled by level into everything another couples into selects through at least their pooled coupling; its closure is exactly the union of the two under the hypothesis. Knowing another's law is no coupling.
A pool admitting its next members through its own pooled coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a reader from outside is the witness's exit.

Theorem (any type; the criteria, the fixed-point equivalence and the term language supplied). Self-reference does not certify itself, and the reference back of a bound use is stipulated rather than derived.

Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; completing it step by step is incomplete at every step. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability not stated.

account_adds.en: What a second reader gains exactly: the union, and no more; and an unfolding incomplete at every step, in a stated form.

source_adds.en: The blind spot of a distinction in use as a general epistemic law, and the regress of observers as constitutive of modern society.

name.en: Act always so as to increase the number of choices

source.work: Heinz von Foerster, On Constructing a Reality (1973); Ethics and Second-Order Cybernetics (1990)
source.locator: the ethical imperative; locator as cited in theories/becoming/history/CYBERNETICS.md, unverified here

sense.en: An ethical imperative stated outright: act always so as to increase the number of choices. Von Foerster offers it as an imperative for an observer who takes responsibility for what it constructs, with no appeal to an outside authority.

reading.en: The comparison stands only in history/CYBERNETICS.md. Its form joins C, which orders by widening what can form. Three partings: he asserts, while C is an unasserted premise and the continuation condition, also unasserted, fixes scope; the ethics does not derive from the condition. Number is one neutral weighting, deciding mixed comparisons widening leaves open. And whose choices count is scope, which his count leaves unstated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights). One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; one weight for every item ranks by number. Calling widening better is C, a premise the account does not assert.

account_adds.en: That counting choices is one order among those widening is agreed by, and that it ranks where they do not; that C cannot be got from what reads no order (`Becoming.ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).

source_adds.en: The imperative's stance: an ethics addressed to an observer's own responsibility. It stands in history/CYBERNETICS.md, not live.

name.en: Levels of learning, and double-loop learning

source.work: Gregory Bateson, Steps to an Ecology of Mind (1972); Chris Argyris and Donald Schön, Organizational Learning (1978)
source.locator: Bateson, The Logical Categories of Learning and Communication; Argyris and Schön locator unverified

sense.en: Learning has levels: change in response, change in how responses are chosen (learning to learn), and, rarely, change in the set of those. Double-loop learning changes the governing norm, not only the action. Higher levels are what real change is said to need.

reading.en: 08 places Bateson's levels as the tower's scheme, with no law of possibility, and the tower law gives what levels cannot do: a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible. So 'higher' does not by itself open more; what grows is the possible with something held, only where it changes. 03 says plainly that its revision law leaves the norm fixed. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, witnesses). A rule changing its own rule adds nothing to its whole possible; a tower of rules with no top adds nothing either. The possible with a part held grows only where the part changes; endless change of the part does not suffice.

Theorem (any types; near-definitional, with witnesses). A course opens a correction by revising the reading along one process. Reading: its relation to double-loop learning depends on whether inquiry changes a governing norm, which it does not here: the acceptability is fixed.

account_adds.en: That towers add nothing to the whole possible, stated as a law on any process.

source_adds.en: Change of a governing norm, which no law models; learning III and its psychological content.

name.en: Ostrom's design principles read as exits

source.work: Elinor Ostrom, Governing the Commons (1990)

sense.en: Long-enduring common-pool institutions share eight features: clear boundaries, rules fitted to local conditions, collective choice by those affected, monitoring accountable to users, graduated sanctions, cheap conflict resolution, recognized right to organize, nested enterprises. Empirical regularities from cases, not a blueprint or a proof of sufficiency.

reading.en: Reading the principles as exits is PLAN's frame. Boundaries: an entry rule's band, which 05 itself sets beside Ostrom, and where a rule can be kept and still end the level. Monitoring: a reader's schedule within the margin. Collective choice: a rule read through a pool, though who decides is not modelled. Conflict: a loop closing through a link giving back less. Nesting: joint plans, division only. CD §5's "No institution is modelled on the spine" looks stale beside 05 §12. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; a family of models). A minimal model of one kind of institution, an entry rule on a shared stock; a rule held exactly within a band. Not modelled: sanctions, who decides a revision, conduct other than entry. Reading: Ostrom 1990 treats boundary rules as held by those they govern; this reads the entry rule only.

Theorem (World; balance). A reader reading one condition a step keeps it within its margin m, against draws of at most d a step withdrawn l steps after a reading, exactly where it reads it within every a steps, for (a + l)d ≤ m < (a + 1 + l)d.
Theorem (any type: a paced rule). Where a rule reads the fast configuration only through what a pool reads, rules part at a reading step only where the pool's reading parts.

Theorem (World: balance). Takes that are what the leaves of a realized joint plan draw, parts' footprints within their whole's and apart, are within what is given. Nested plans: a form of division only, with no layer governing. It does not show an actual division is so.
Theorem (any type). A loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less. 05 §4 reads this [AI reading, D48] as bounded conflict: compensation, arbitration, absorption.

account_adds.en: An exact band for an entry rule, including that the rule's being held does not decide the stock's fate; an exact monitoring window.

source_adds.en: Graduated sanctions, fit to local conditions, monitors accountable to users, external recognition, and above all the empirical base: decades of field cases. 05's Open names a study weighing Ostrom's account; none is run.

name.en: Users can govern a commons themselves

source.work: Elinor Ostrom, Governing the Commons (1990); Ostrom, Gardner and Walker, Rules, Games, and Common-Pool Resources (1994)
source.locator: 1990 chapter 1 on Hardin and the metaphors; 1994 chapters on communication and sanctioning experiments, locator unverified

sense.en: Against Hardin: neither state nor market is the only way out. Field cases show users sustaining commons by their own rules over centuries. In the lab, communication and chosen sanctions sharply raise yields above the non-cooperative prediction, overappropriation being only the baseline with no communication.

reading.en: One record cites the overappropriation half, and reads Ostrom 1990 as coupling or lowered capacity, narrower than rules, monitoring and sanctions users choose. I found nothing live citing the communication and sanctioning findings. The laws concern optimizers on stated models, so no contradiction follows; but self-governing restraint has no law, every horizon here is finite, and how pools form and last is open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). Several optimizers whose withdrawal with the rest's exceeds r at every step lose the dependence however small each capacity. Its correspondence cites overappropriation (Ostrom, Gardner and Walker 1994) and reads [AI]: what keeps a commons is a coupling into it or a lowered capacity, "the means Ostrom (1990) found communities use".
Beside joint excess: restraint kept by punishing strategies in an equilibrium of the commons played without end (Fudenberg and Maskin 1986; Dutta 1995); here every horizon is finite.
Open: how pools form, last and resist capture; revision that is not a best response; a discriminating study weighed against accounts including Ostrom's.

T3's evidence: LLM fishers kept no dependent they were not told of, under any instruction (IN1). Its frozen predictions on installing the direction mostly failed; with a round of talk, R1 to R4 held for gpt-5.4-mini and only R2 for gpt-4.1-mini. The only live touch on talk I found, and not on people.

account_adds.en: Conditions under which a member's restraint cannot be selected by a score: where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps. Small mixed tests on learners and LLM agents, none on people.

source_adds.en: That communication and self-chosen sanctions work, in field and laboratory; that people are not the drawers of the optimum laws. No test on the spine has human participants (CD §5).

name.en: Purpose as negative feedback

source.work: Arturo Rosenblueth, Norbert Wiener and Julian Bigelow, Behavior, Purpose and Teleology (1943); Norbert Wiener, Cybernetics (1948)
source.locator: Philosophy of Science 10 for the 1943 paper; Wiener locator unverified

sense.en: Purposeful behaviour is behaviour directed to a goal and corrected by negative feedback from its distance to the goal. Teleology is thereby made a matter of mechanism, the same in animal and machine: the founding move of cybernetics.

reading.en: The account keeps the loop and takes back what it was to explain. A target is any condition on the configuration, and how it forms is not modelled. A loop does not mark what regulates for itself: 04 reads a thermostat as having one too, the difference being a stock buying time. And a regulator at its set point protects nothing beyond it by that feedback. No account of purpose is offered in its place. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest). A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets it.

Reading [AI, new]. What tells the member rebuilt from the level from a thermostat, whose reader is given, and from a reader made from outside, is not a loop. Both have loops. It is that its stock buys it time and that its end does not come back.

Formations each holding a set point, their losses together above what the rest gives a gated condition, end it however small each one's loss. What protects what lies beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for rest with a target met, and that holding a set point can end what lies beyond it.

source_adds.en: Teleology explained by feedback, across animal and machine; Wiener's information and control as one science. A target's forming is not modelled here.

name.en: Any determinate system organizes itself, and "good" is relative

source.work: W. Ross Ashby, Principles of the Self-Organizing System (1962)

sense.en: A determinate dynamic system goes to equilibrium, so it selects its own attractor with no outside selector, and in this sense any such system self-organizes. No organization is good in an absolute sense, only relative to a given environment. Paraphrased from memory.

reading.en: Within finite listings the basin law has the first half's form: every course enters what returns, and each basin holds one cycle, by no selector. The second half meets 02's refusal to rank regions and 05's reading that attraction is not continuation. Ashby's "adapted organisms" goes further than these laws do; the account separates being drawn from returning, and either from going on. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under any determined law courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m and each basin holds one cycle.
Theorem (any process). Every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return. Runs are infinite, so a dead end is drawn vacuously: the law does not say a course entering the region exists.
Reading [AI, D65]. Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support.

account_adds.en: The branching case, where being drawn and returning part; that an attractor need not be a continuation.

source_adds.en: The claim that such systems develop parts adapted to the rest of the system, read as organisms; a general theory of self-organization by this route.

changes.why: Targets read and hold. Added the law that even a goal over the shared level is no guarantee, the sharpest scope on restoring feedback, which the mapper missed.

The mapper said exclusion is not stated, but the drawn course fixes or loses a kind, so exclusion has a form under drawing. Its "a lock can favour those without control" had no support I could find; replaced with what 02 states of a standing score.
T3 and the optimum law read; the qualifiers (room as a hypothesis, no evaluation, the trained-systems clause conjectured) are there. The word "wrong" is rightly left to a comparison.

Added the optimum law, which is what a formation doing well by the letter does to what the letter omits; 03 reads the coupling law itself as the proxy problem. Kept the point that evasion has no dynamics here.

The mapper dismissed PLAN's seed "absorbed reading" outright. Absorption is the outcome, a policy undone at the next reading, by a different cause. Marked fresh-reading, since the account never states this connection, and scope, since absorption holds only where the direction is kept.

Added the reply law, the nearest thing to a party reading what was done to it. It is a witness, doubling once by a supplied law, not a derived rise. Noted that "escalation" in the renewal records is another sense.

The mapper's not-carried rested on a false statement, that the capture laws "state a rise or a hold, not a joint decline". 02 and the Lean state falling courses with the rule read monotonically from the share. PLAN's seed holds as a form; the source's cause and exits do not.

Kept not-carried, since the core is absent, and named neighbours the mapper missed: 04's reader rebuilt from the supply, 05 §12's rule taught from outside, 02's substitution, and 05 §10's sentence on a lost capacity.

Corrected a contrast: as I recall the essay, Meadows herself says numbers matter when they push a higher item past a threshold, so thresholds do not cut against her. Said why the possible's law is a target, which the mapper left unstated.
Dropped how-fast-a-rule-may-change: the pace law bounds what a slow rule can fix of a fast level, not a corrective loop's overshoot. Added the row with the overcompensating witness.

The mapper's targets were loop bounds that bear only on onset. Better forms exist and were missed: more at first and less past a bound; a switch that keeps a formation active while the condition goes; and a difference that returns only where the rest responds.
Searched and read keeping-forgoes and optima-rebuild; more-needs-renewers exists and is a law of arising. No lagged investment decision read from performance. Stays not-carried.
Targets read. 03 reads requisite variety on relations, 08 marks regulation as restating it. The claim that no statement counts variety held under search.

Relation changed from scope to divergence: 03 does not bound their theorem, it says the theorem concerns something else and that nothing of having to model is proved here. No contradiction is claimed.
Reading held; the target now carries its standing and says the Ashby comparison is the AI's reading in the record.

A not-carried with no targets hid the real parting. Beer asserts a universal necessary-and-sufficient structure; the account's root laws cannot, its required organization is conditional, and it proves that separate keepability does not decide the joint. Made a fresh divergence.

Relation changed from divergence to scope: the maxim stands as a diagnostic, and the laws give exactly how far acts fix an order. Noted that the account has no purpose of a system: 05 §12 lists purposes as not modelled.

The mapper said his separation is not shown. The exit from a margin holds fluctuation size and margin apart, so a wide swing with a wide margin has a form, as a bound. And 05 §10 reads a shock into another retained region, so "another domain" is not wholly absent.
Read 02's does-not-show, 05 §10's four routes. Stays not-carried. The word "release" in 02 and 07 is another sense, now listed in the search.

Relation changed from scope to divergence. The mapper missed that 04 rejects a fixed ladder, which is what panarchy's nesting by speed and size asserts. A sentence with no target ("has remember's form") is now tied to Restored.returns in 05.
Replaced a clause in the target I could not find at its home ("which conditions a formation observes is a parameter") with the Clearing witness, which is the home's words and closer to resonance.
Targets read; the contrast is labelled as the reader's, and the ethics clause names both premises unasserted.
The mapper's "a collective is a pool, part of what it moves" I could not find live, so it is gone. Added 08's sentence, which meets part of Luhmann's point.

Relation changed from scope to divergence: the account does not correct their definition, it declines to define life by closure, and 04 names another mark, that a stock buys time and the end does not return. Correspondences are marked not proved in the record.
Targets read: withholding absorbs, symmetry blocks a shared form, a swap-symmetric predicate singles out none. Waiting supplied, as the entry says.

Replaced the runaway target, whose stated gloss was not the home's words and rests on a stock unobserved by hypothesis, with the Clearing witness, which is what the divergence actually needs. History/CYBERNETICS.md was read: it states the same parting.
Dropped a-reading-kept-by-its-update: a closed region is not a fixed point of a recursion. Added the witness that cuts against "whatever the start".

The mapper named self-reference in the reading with no target, and missed the diagonal, the closest form of "no last observer". The phrase attributed to von Foerster is marked as recalled, attribution uncertain.
Read history/CYBERNETICS.md lines 45 to 47 and 07's weighting table. Named only in history, so history-only; the parting from C stands, both premises named.
Read 08's sentence and the tower law; 03 says its revision leaves the norm fixed. 08 marks these laws near-definitional or witnesses, and the target says theorem on any process only.

Relation changed from scope to agreement: her principles are stated as regularities, not universally, so there is nothing for scope to correct. Nesting is not wholly absent, as the mapper said: joint plans nest. Added §12's own warning that a held rule can end the level.

The mapper missed that the same record's correspondence credits Ostrom 1990 with coupling or lowered capacity, which is narrower than her finding: rules, monitoring and sanctions chosen by users. That reduction belongs in the entry.
First-order cybernetics' founding claim was missing, and 04 parts from it plainly: a loop is not the mark. A divergence the map should show.
The mapper took Ashby's variety, regulator and ultrastability and missed his claim that determinate dynamics select with no outside selector. The basin law has its form.
